control_settings.description: General control settings for this tool

aircraft_exchange_file_name.description: Specify the name of the exchange file

aircraft_exchange_file_directory.description: Specify the direction in which the aircraft exchange file can be found

own_tool_level.description: Specify the tool level of this tool

console_output.description: Selector to specify the console output. Selector: mode_0 (Off) / mode_1 (only out/err/warn) / mode_2 (1 + info) / mode_3 (2 + debug)

log_file_output.description: Selector to specify the log file output. Selector: mode_0 (Off) / mode_1 (only out/err/warn) / mode_2 (1 + info) / mode_3 (2 + debug)

plot_output.description: Specify the way plotting shall be handled

enable.description: Switch to enable plotting. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

copy_plotting_files.description: Switch if plotting files shall be copied. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

delete_plotting_files_from_tool_folder.description: Switch if plotting files shall be deleted from folder. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

report_output.description: Switch to generate an HTML report. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

tex_report.description: Switch to generate a Tex report. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

write_info_files.description: Switch to generate info files. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

log_file.description: Specify the name of the log file

inkscape_path.description: Path to the inkscape application (DEFAULT: Use inkscape from the UNICADO repo structure)

gnuplot_path.description: Path to the gnuplot application (DEFAULT: Use gnuplot from the UNICADO repo structure)

mission_selector.description: Pick a mission. Selector: design_mission / study_mission / requirements_mission

maximum_operating_mach_number.description: Specify the maximum operating Mach number by its delta to the initial cruise Mach number

enable.description: Switch to enable the specification via initial cruise Mach number + delta. Switch: true (On) / false (Off-> read from aircraft exchange file)

delta.description: Difference between maximum operating Mach number (MMO) and initial cruise (IC) Mach number: delta = MMO - IC

adapt_climb_speed_schedule.description: Second calibrated airspeed (CAS) within climb adapted to crossover altitude

enable.description: Switch to enable crossover altitude adaption. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

crossover_altitude.description: Crossover altitude to which the second calibrated airspeed (CAS) shall be adapted

climb_thrust_setting.description: Selector to set the thrust rating within climb/acceleration segments. Selector: mode_0 (Takeoff) / mode_1 (Climb) / mode_2 (Maximum continuous) / mode_3 (Cruise)

maximum_rate_of_climb.description: Limit the rate of climb (ROC) to a preset value during Climb segments; values less then 0: Use full thrust as limit

output_file_name.description: Specify the name of the created mission file

terminal_operation_time.description: Specify the time at the terminal for stopovers

takeoff_procedure.description: Selector for the takeoff procedure. Selector: mode_0 (standard) / mode_1 (ICAO-A Take-Off Procedure (not implemented yet)) / mode_2 (ICAO-A Take-Off Procedure (not implemented yet)) / mode_3 (Standard 19 seat commuter)

approach_procedure.description: Selector for the approach procedure. Selector: mode_0 (standard) / mode_1 (Continuous descent approach (not implemented yet)) / mode_2 (steep Continuous descent approach (not implemented yet)) / mode_3 (Standard 19 seat commuter)

taxi_time_origin.description: Time needed for taxiing at origin.

taxi_time_destination.description: Time needed for taxiing at destination.

auto_select_initial_cruise_altitude.description: Switch to activate automatic selection of the initial cruise altitude (ICA). Switch: true (On [ICA design: FL330, ICA study: FL350]) / false (Off)

auto_select_flight_level.description: Specify if and how the flight level selection is automated

enable.description: Switch to activate automatic selection of the flight level. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

no_steps.description: Switch to never change from initial cruise altitude (ICA) -> ICA = altitude for whole cruise. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

round_to_regular_flight_level.description: Switch to round to flight levels (FL) within 20 FL (= 2000 ft) intervals; e.g. FL 330 or 350. Switch: true (On) / false (Off)

auto_climb_altitude_steps.description: Altitude step distance in cruise flight with automatic altitude adjustment

auto_rate_of_climb_steps.description: Rate of climb limit in cruise with automatic altitude adjustment

alternate_distance.description: Distance from destination to alternate aerodrome

engine_warmup_time.description: Running time of the engines before take-off

taxiing_procedure.description: Selector for the taxiing procedure. Selector: mode_0 (Propulsion Taxiing) / mode_1 (Electric Taxiing)

copy_mach_number.description: Switch if the Mach number is copied from the design mission's requirements block. Switch: true (On) / false (Off; only for parameter studies with Mach number variation)

copy_initial_cruise_altitude.description: Switch if the initial cruise altitude (ICA) is copied from the design mission's requirements block. Switch: true (On) / false (Off; only for parameter studies with ICA variation without altitude optimization)
